name: What types of damage do commercial restoration services cover?

mainEntity.name: What types of damage do commercial restoration services cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial restoration services typically cover a wide range of damage types, including water damage from floods, leaks, or burst pipes; fire and smoke damage, which often includes soot and odor removal; storm damage from wind, rain, or hail; and mold remediation. These services address structural integrity, interior finishes, and content recovery.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial restoration covers water, fire, smoke, storm damage, and mold remediation, addressing structural issues and interior finishes.
